name: Rich Circle Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Rich Circle Development Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of semiconductors. Its offerings encompass a range of technological components, including integrated circuits, memory chips, digital communication products, and computer peripherals. In addition to its tech operations, the company maintains a presence in the real estate market, undertaking the development of buildings and housing, as well as the sale and rental of properties. Founded in 1987, the firm's headquarters are situated in Taipei, Taiwan. The company was rebranded in January 2024, changing its name to Rich Circle Development Co., Ltd. from its previous identity as AverLogic Technologies, Corp.
